## Professional Overview
Chester Agsamosam is a Software Engineer with 9 years of software development experience (since 2017), with deep specialization in high-scale frontend architecture using Vue.js (versions 2 and 3), Svelte, and TypeScript. 

He combines enterprise UI expertise—including production engineering for a premier Philippine digital wallet serving millions of users—with Laravel full-stack range and AI-augmented development workflows.
